clues.text: When Adam and Eve's firstborn son was born, Eve said she had brought forth a man with the LORD's help.
This tiller of the soil brought fruit of the ground to the LORD, but God had no regard for his offering.
He asked his brother to go out to the field, and there he rose up and killed him.
When this son of Adam grew angry, the LORD warned him that sin was crouching at his door.
This son of Adam built a city and named it after his own son, Enoch.
Told by the LORD he would be a fugitive and a wanderer, he said his punishment was more than he could bear.
Jude warns of false teachers who have traveled this man's path, alongside Balaam's error and Korah's rebellion.
